# Slab

Onchain GitHub. Profiles, repos, and README on a MagicBlock public Ephemeral Rollup. Pages on Irys.

## Product

- Name: Slab
- Category: onchain GitHub
- Chains: Solana (base) + MagicBlock public ER
- Storage: Irys pages

## Pages

- [Home](/): product
- [Console](/console): SQL workstation. Isolation is slab + wallet + ns.
- [Docs](/docs): product docs
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy)
- [Terms and Conditions](/terms)
- [Refund Policy](/refunds)
- [Cookie Policy](/cookies)

## Do not confuse with

Slab is not a hosted Postgres. Isolation is slab + wallet + namespace.
Repos, profiles, and Irys pages are public.
